sections.title: Your proposal
sections.description: Describe a change that would make this place easier, safer or more pleasant to use. Your proposal is sent for review and does not change the map.

questions.text: What kind of improvement do you propose?

options.text: A better street, path or crossing

questions.text: What would you like to change here?

options.text: People in a wheelchair or with a pram
People on a bike or e-scooter

en.#Describe a change that would make this: Describe a change that would make this place easier, safer or more pleasant to use. Your proposal is sent for review and does not change the map.
en.#What kind of improvement do you propose: What kind of improvement do you propose?
en.#A better street, path or crossing: A better street, path or crossing
en.#What would you like to change here?: What would you like to change here?
en.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: People in a wheelchair or with a pram
en.#People on a bike or e-scooter: People on a bike or e-scooter

it.#Describe a change that would make this: Descrivi un cambiamento che renderebbe questo luogo più facile, più sicuro o più piacevole da usare. La tua proposta viene inviata per la revisione e non modifica la mappa.
it.#A better street, path or crossing: Una strada, un percorso o un attraversamento migliore
it.#A better service or entrance: Un servizio o un ingresso migliore
it.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: Persone in sedia a rotelle o con passeggino

fr.#Describe a change that would make this: Décrivez un changement qui rendrait ce lieu plus facile, plus sûr ou plus agréable à utiliser. Votre proposition est envoyée pour vérification et ne modifie pas la carte.
fr.#A better street, path or crossing: Une rue, un chemin ou une traversée améliorés
fr.#Better lighting or safety: Un meilleur éclairage ou plus de sécurité
fr.#A better service or entrance: Un service ou une entrée améliorés
fr.#Who would it help most?: À qui cela serait-il le plus utile ?
fr.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: Personnes en fauteuil roulant ou avec une poussette
fr.#People on a bike or e-scooter: Personnes à vélo ou en trottinette

de.#Describe a change that would make this: Beschreiben Sie eine Änderung, die diesen Ort leichter, sicherer oder angenehmer nutzbar machen würde. Ihr Vorschlag wird zur Prüfung gesendet und ändert die Karte nicht.
de.#What kind of improvement do you propose: Welche Art von Verbesserung schlagen Sie vor?
de.#A better street, path or crossing: Eine bessere Straße, ein besserer Weg oder Übergang
de.#Who would it help most?: Wem würde es am meisten helfen?
de.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: Menschen im Rollstuhl oder mit Kinderwagen

tr.#Describe a change that would make this: Bu yeri kullanmayı daha kolay, daha güvenli veya daha keyifli hâle getirecek bir değişikliği açıklayın. Öneriniz incelemeye gönderilir ve haritayı değiştirmez.
tr.#A better street, path or crossing: Daha iyi bir sokak, yol veya geçit
tr.#A better service or entrance: Daha iyi bir hizmet veya giriş
tr.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: Tekerlekli sandalye kullananlar veya bebek arabası olanlar

fa.#Describe a change that would make this: تغییری را توضیح دهید که استفاده از این مکان را آسان‌تر، ایمن‌تر یا خوشایندتر کند. پیشنهاد شما برای بررسی ارسال می‌شود و نقشه را تغییر نمی‌دهد.
fa.#What would you like to change here?: دوست دارید اینجا چه چیزی تغییر کند؟
fa.#Who would it help most?: بیشتر به چه کسانی کمک می‌کند؟
fa.#People on a bike or e-scooter: افراد با دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی

hu.#Describe a change that would make this: Írjon le egy olyan változtatást, amely könnyebbé, biztonságosabbá vagy kellemesebbé tenné ennek a helynek a használatát. Javaslatát ellenőrzésre továbbítjuk, és az nem módosítja a térképet.

ar.#Describe a change that would make this: صِف تغييرًا يجعل استخدام هذا المكان أسهل أو أكثر أمانًا أو أكثر راحة. يُرسَل اقتراحك للمراجعة ولا يغيّر الخريطة.
ar.#A better street, path or crossing: شارع أو ممر أو معبر أفضل
ar.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: مستخدمو الكراسي المتحركة أو عربات الأطفال

pl.#Describe a change that would make this: Opisz zmianę, dzięki której korzystanie z tego miejsca byłoby łatwiejsze, bezpieczniejsze lub przyjemniejsze. Twoja propozycja zostanie przekazana do weryfikacji i nie zmienia mapy.
pl.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: Osobom na wózku lub z wózkiem dziecięcym
pl.#People on a bike or e-scooter: Osobom na rowerze lub hulajnodze elektrycznej

da.#Describe a change that would make this: Beskriv en ændring, der ville gøre dette sted lettere, sikrere eller mere behageligt at bruge. Dit forslag sendes til gennemgang og ændrer ikke kortet.
da.#A better street, path or crossing: En bedre gade, sti eller overgang
da.#What would you like to change here?: Hvad vil du gerne ændre her?
da.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: Personer i kørestol eller med barnevogn

lb.#Describe a change that would make this: Beschreift eng Ännerung, déi dës Plaz méi einfach, méi sécher oder méi agreabel ze benotze géif maachen. Äre Virschlag gëtt fir d’Iwwerpréiwung geschéckt an ännert d’Kaart net.
lb.#A better street, path or crossing: Eng besser Strooss, e bessere Wee oder Iwwergang
lb.#What would you like to change here?: Wat géift Dir hei gär änneren?
lb.#Who would it help most?: Wiem géif et am meeschten hëllefen?
lb.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: Leit am Rollstull oder mat Kannerwon

nl.#Describe a change that would make this: Beschrijf een verandering die deze plek gemakkelijker, veiliger of prettiger in gebruik zou maken. Uw voorstel wordt ter beoordeling verstuurd en verandert de kaart niet.
nl.#What kind of improvement do you propose: Wat voor verbetering stelt u voor?
nl.#A better street, path or crossing: Een betere straat, betere weg of oversteekplaats
nl.#What would you like to change here?: Wat zou u hier willen veranderen?
nl.#Who would it help most?: Wie zou er het meest mee geholpen zijn?
nl.#People in a wheelchair or with a pram: Mensen in een rolstoel of met een kinderwagen
nl.#People on a bike or e-scooter: Mensen op de fiets of e-step
